description: The plot titled “Whisper fine-tunning, type = tiny” illustrates how WER changes over training epochs for five tiny-model fine-tuning/quantization variants. The x-axis is labeled “epoch,” uses a linear scale, and runs from 0 to 6 with integer tick marks at every 1 epoch. The y-axis is labeled “WER,” uses a linear scale, and spans roughly from 20 to 70 with major ticks at 30, 40, 50, 60, and 70. The “tiny AdaLoRA_int4” series is drawn as a solid line with circular markers and decreases from about 69 at epoch 0 to about 40 at epoch 6, passing through approximately 60 (epoch 1), 55 (epoch 2), 45 (epoch 3), and 40 (epoch 4), then around 37–38 at epoch 5 before returning near 40 at epoch 6. The “tiny AdaLoRA_int8” series is a solid line with square markers and drops from about 60 at epoch 0 to about 32 at epoch 6, with intermediate values near 51 (epoch 1), 50 (epoch 2), 44 (epoch 3), 37–38 (epoch 4), and about 35 (epoch 5). The “tiny int4” series is shown with a dashed line and circular markers, declining from about 69 at epoch 0 to about 37 at epoch 6, with points near 55 (epoch 1), 50 (epoch 2), 45 (epoch 3), 40 (epoch 4), and about 39 (epoch 5). The “tiny int8” series uses a dashed line with square markers and decreases from about 60 at epoch 0 to about 36–37 at epoch 6, moving through roughly 47 (epoch 1), 46 (epoch 2), 43 (epoch 3), 39 (epoch 4), and about 37 (epoch 5). The “tiny full” series is a dotted line with triangle markers and stays in the mid-to-high 20s, going from about 29 at epoch 0 to about 23 at epoch 6, with values around 27 (epoch 1), 27 (epoch 2), 24 (epoch 3), 24 (epoch 4), and about 23–24 (epoch 5).
